description: This file defines a React context provider (DataProvider) and hook (useDataContext) for managing and caching user and session data within a React application. It loads data once on app mount and provides refresh functions, along with loading and error states.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Hook to consume the shared DataContext providing cached user and session data.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: React component that loads and caches user and session data on mount, providing context values and refresh functions.
